# Maulana Suhail Ahmad Online Quran Academy

> Learn Quran from Home, From Anywhere in the World.
> Premier India-wide distance learning Quran academy delivering authentic 1-on-1 personalized lessons in Noorani Qaida, Quran Kareem Nazra, Hifz-e-Quran, and Aalim studies under traditional scholarly supervision.

## Core Identity & Verification
- **Academy Name**: Maulana Suhail Ahmad Online Quran Academy
- **Short Name**: Suhail Online Quran Academy
- **Founder & Academic Director**: Maulana Suhail Ahmad
- **Registered Physical Center**: Village Nairana, District Muzaffarnagar, Uttar Pradesh - 251203, India
- **Official Telephone / WhatsApp**: +91 75055 11251
- **Email**: info@maulanasuhailquranacademy.com
- **Website**: https://maulana-suhail-ahmad-quran-academy.vercel.app
- **Pedagogical Standards**: Traditional Dars-e-Nizami, Sanad-backed Tajweed articulation (Makharij & Sifaat), classical Sabaq-Sabqi-Manzil memorization methodology.

## Approved Courses & Exact Monthly Fees (INR)
Only the following four courses are offered:

1. **Noorani Qaida**
   - **Monthly Fee**: ₹1,399 / month
   - **Target Audience**: Complete beginners, young children (ages 4+), and adult beginners.
   - **Curriculum**: 29 Arabic alphabets (Mufradat), Makharij articulation points, compound shapes (Murakkabat), short vowels (Harakat), Tanween, Sukoon, Tashdeed, and Madd.
   - **URL**: https://maulana-suhail-ahmad-quran-academy.vercel.app/courses/noorani-qaida

2. **Quran Kareem Nazra**
   - **Monthly Fee**: ₹1,399 / month
   - **Target Audience**: Students who can read Arabic letters and wish to recite the complete Holy Quran with fluent Tajweed.
   - **Curriculum**: 30 Juz recitation, Noon Sakinah & Tanween rules, Meem Sakin rules, stopping signs (Waqf & Ibtida), and breath control.
   - **URL**: https://maulana-suhail-ahmad-quran-academy.vercel.app/courses/quran-kareem-nazra

3. **Hifz-e-Quran**
   - **Monthly Fee**: ₹1,899 / month
   - **Target Audience**: Students dedicated to full Quran memorization.
   - **Methodology**: Classical three-tiered retention: Sabaq (new memorization), Sabqi (recent revision), and Manzil (long-term revision).
   - **URL**: https://maulana-suhail-ahmad-quran-academy.vercel.app/courses/hifz-e-quran

4. **Aalim Course**
   - **Monthly Fee**: ₹1,399 / month
   - **Target Audience**: Students pursuing advanced classical Islamic studies.
   - **Curriculum**: Arabic grammar (Sarf & Nahw), Hadith methodology (Usool al-Hadith), Islamic Jurisprudence (Fiqh), Tafseer, and Seerah.
   - **URL**: https://maulana-suhail-ahmad-quran-academy.vercel.app/courses/aalim-course

## Free Trial & Demo Policy
- **Policy**: 100% Free 1 to 2 days 1-on-1 Trial Class before enrollment.
- **Requirement**: No credit card, no registration fee, no obligation.
- **Booking**: https://maulana-suhail-ahmad-quran-academy.vercel.app/free-trial or WhatsApp +91 75055 11251.

## Faculty & Teaching Model
- **Format**: Strictly private 1-on-1 live audio/video sessions via Google Meet and Zoom.
- **Tutors**: Certified male Qaris & Huffaz for brothers; certified female Qariyas & Alimas for sisters and young daughters.
- **Languages**: Classes conducted in English, Urdu, Hindi, and Arabic.
- **Hours**: 24/7 flexible scheduling matching India, UAE, Saudi Arabia, UK, USA, Canada, and Australia timezones.
